attachments.title: BCI and Gaming / Survey
attachments.text: The following survey is designed to gather information about the use of brain-computer interfaces (BCI) among gamers. The survey is structured so that you should be able to complete the form in less then 5 minutes with no prior knowledge about BCI technology. BCI headsets are a specific hardware designed to allow users to communicate information to an external machine using neural activity (i.e. by "thinking"). There are several uses of this technology. In the clinical setting, BCIs are used as assistive technologies for several classes of neurological patients including patients suffering from locked-in syndrome, quadriplegia and amyotrophic lateral sclerosis. Outside the clinics, BCIs are used to offer more personalized experience in entertainment, marketing and gaming where they are used as alternative controllers to the joypad, the keyboard or the mouse. Investigator and corresponding researcher: Marcello Ienca, Institute of Biomedical Ethics, University of Basel Bernoullistrasse 28, 4056 Basel (Switzerland) Email: <mailto:marcello.ienca@unibas.ch|marcello.ienca@unibas.ch>
